subject: Change ascii logo with temporal valkey logo (#77)
reason: The change only swaps the ASCII-art banner string in src/asciilogo.h for a Valkey-branded one. Its sole consumer is the snprintf in server.c's logo printing, and the new string keeps exactly the same printf specifiers in the same order and types (%s, %s, %d, %s, %s, %d, %ld) matching the seven arguments, well under the 16KB buffer. The banner is cosmetic startup-log output (shown only on a TTY or with always-show-logo) and affects no command reply, data path, replication, or persistence, so there is no behaviour for a scenario to exercise.
